notes.title: Rise: Race the future - VR - Update v1.2
notes.content:
[h1]New features VR:[/h1]
- Support for [b]OpenVR[/b] protocol
- Quick recentering of the VR position with the Start button.
- 2 game launching options (VR or normal)

[h1]New features Camera (Options menu > Settings):[/h1]
- Distance adjustment
- Height adjustment
- Rotation delay adjustment (at 0% the camera is always aligned to the car)

[h1]Best practice for the VR functionality:[/h1]
- Performance = Set the shadows to "Low" or "Very Low"
- Visual comfort = Disable the Bloom
- Gameplay = Set the camera delay between 60% and 80%
- Visual quality  : the FXXA is better than MSAA for the VR (softer)

[h1]Modification:[/h1]
- [b]Directional Pad[/b] used for menu navigation (replacing Left Stick)

notes.title: Rise: Race the future - Update v1.02
notes.content:
News:
- Added option for 5.1 and 7.1 sound (experimental) (go to Options > Settings)
- Small CPU optimizations
- Internal changes for the next update

Bug Fix:
- Objective 2 of Challenge 3-8 (works correctly  - menu and race)
- Sometimes the cars unlocking was not happening at the right time

notes.title: Rise: Race the future - Update 1.01
notes.content:
News :
- Camera "Look back", Button B (If you already have a saved game, go to Options > Controls > assign a new button)
- Unit of measure km/h - Mph (go to Options > Settings)
- Informative texts on start screen
- Name assigned automatically when creating a new save (you can edit it), full game controller support
- Lower Music volume when the game is paused

Bug Fix :
- Challenge 3-8 and 7-3 (not achievable in some difficulty modes)
- Wrong Spanish translation
